subs.note: Leonhard Lechner. The movements of the mass, each on its own.

items.title: Kyrie (Lechner, Missa Domine dominus noster)
items.desc: Leonhard Lechner, Missa Domine dominus noster, Kyrie, 1584. 6 voices (Cantus, Sexta vox, Altus, Tenor, Quinta vox, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
